# Campus Bite

Thank you for downloading Campus Bite.

## new inner workings

- changed the update compare version logic to use semver instead of numeric comparison, this will allow for better versioning and update management.

## APKs

### UNIVERSAL
Works on almost any android device but large size.

### ARM64-v8a
Recommended for almost all Android devices.

### ARMv7
For older Android phones.

### x86_64
For emulators and Intel devices.
